text:
claire: Heads up — we have a docs PR surge at sprint end. 7 PRs in review queue that touch SDK examples + the migration guide. Can folks pick reviewers? @docs-oncall please advise

devon: I can take 2 SDK example PRs (PR#4321, PR#4324). Prefer quick pass tonight. :+1:

ashwin: I'll take the migration guide ones, but CI preview is flaky. I'll re-run once someone fixes the linkcheck error.

maya: Which ones are linkcheck failing? I can do a pass tomorrow morning before the merge window.

claire: linkcheck failures on PR#4330 and PR#4331 — relative links to the new onboarding page. small fix, but blocks docs-preview.

ashwin: noted. pinging the author to update paths. @ashwin: @sylvia can you update the links to /guides/onboarding/new-flow?

ci-bot: Build queued for PR#4321, PR#4324, PR#4330. Docs preview available at https://docs-preview.internal/branch/2151234567 (may be delayed)

maya: I'll handle PR#4330 linkcheck and re-run preview at ~07:30 PT. If green, can we merge in the 08:00-09:00 PT merge window?

devon: Yes, 08:00-09:00 PT works. I'll set my calendar to be available for quick follow-up.

claire: Ideally keep merges in small batches so we don't swamp the preview and CI. Suggested order: SDK examples first (4321,4324), then migration guide (4330,4331), then minor snippets (4335,4336,4337).

maya: Agreed. Also leaving a note: if any PR changes code snippets, include a short comment with the test command we used — helps reviewers. e.g.:
```
python examples/run_quick_example.py --lang python
```

ashwin: PR#4331 author updated links, re-run looks green. ci-bot shows preview live.

ci-bot: Preview for PR#4331: SUCCESS. No linkcheck errors.

claire: Great. devon and maya — please proceed in that order when you're ready. If anyone hits flakey CI, tag me and we'll hold the rest.

devon: Starting merge for PR#4321 now. Command: `./scripts/docs-merge --pr 4321 --dry-run` then real merge. Will report back.

ci-bot: PR#4321 merge check: PASS.

devon: Merged PR#4321 :tada:

maya: PR#4330 merged after link fix. Leaving a patch note in the PR for the snippet test command.

claire: Thanks everyone — coverage looks good for the sprint rollover. I'll update the rotation sheet with who picked up the surge. :seedling:

ashwin: Quick follow-up: can we add a check in the docs CI for relative link patterns to catch this earlier? Filing a ticket.

claire: Please add to the docs backlog and tag infra for prioritization.

docs-bot: NOTE: docs-rotation updated by claire — devon (SDK examples), maya (linkfix + merge window), ashwin (migration guide).
